families.hypothesis_note: H-VOL-REGIME-WRAP-01 (spec/research/F006-hypothesis-vol-regime-wrap.md): a causal realized-vol-percentile regime (LOW/MID/HIGH, hysteresis, W=100, edges 25/75, margin 10) switches a frozen Donchian(20) breakout trigger between breakout mode (HIGH), inverted/mean-revert mode (LOW), and flat (MID). H1: mean train1_net_pnl > 0 for at least one of the 3 frozen names across its 10-series pool. H2 (conditional): at least one series of an H1-passing name clears the monthly promotion checklist.
